name: interpret_ride_shape
about: A ride described in parts keeps its order, ranges and modifiers; no class-wide counts are derived from it.
request: A 60 min class that starts off slow and builds up the momentum. A hilly section, that turns into a tough intervall section, thinking 5-7 short heavy bursts, back on flats, bulding up for a new hilly section, finishing of with a few bursts of power.
